questions.q: What does `.filter()` return when given a function that checks `incident.priority === 1`?
options: A single boolean: true if any incident matches
The count of matching incidents only
A new array containing only the incidents where the function returned true
The original array, modified in place to remove non-matches
questions.explain: filter builds a new array keeping only the items for which the callback function returns true, leaving the original array untouched.
